item.title: “Truly a home:” Women’s shelter to open doors of expanded facility
item.description: Open Door Women’s Shelter celebrates a 3,000-square-foot expansion adding 15 beds, family dorms and 24/7 services; public ribbon-cutting and tours set for Feb. 3 in Washington.

item.title: East high school basketball regionals return to ECU
item.description: The East Regional finals high school basketball games will return to East Carolina University this season. They had been played the past three seasons in Winston-Salem as part of the state finals week.

item.title: Weeds that Winter-Over: Meet the early trouble-makers
item.description: Written by Angela Mason Foster Extension Master Gardener Volunteer January may look like a season of rest, but a quiet little rebellion is underway beneath our feet. While most of the garden sleeps, winter annual weeds are hard at work germinating, spreading, and preparing to take over the moment spring arrives. item.title: Write Again … Like father, like son
item.description: We who love to read books, that is, often come across ideas that are thought-inducing. It’s not necessarily something we may like, or agree with, but it makes us pause and ponder. Two such ponderables are in the book “No Traveller Returns” by Louis L’ Amour, and his son Beau. item.title: Beaufort County forecasted to get 10-14 inches of snow
item.description: Beaufort County is forecast to receive 10–14 inches of snow with high winds, possible whiteout conditions and subfreezing temperatures from late Friday through Monday; residents urged to prepare.
